1.consolidated_definition: Pasta de cemento. Cemento fuerte que se produce calentando una mezcla de materias molidas, tales como calcita, sílice, aluminio y hierro. Anglicismo crudo, poco frecuente. San Juan Cement Co. informó ayer que contrario a su competidor, Puerto Rican Cement, dicha empresa no está bajo investigación del Departamento de Asuntos de Consumidor a pesar de que importa cantidades significativas de clinker para la producción de cemento como lo permite la ley. Durante el año San Juan Cement recibe embarques de miles de toneladas de clinker, o pasta de cemento, provenientes de una planta en Canadá (El Nuevo Día, 23-10-97)
1.en_consolidated_definition: Cement paste. A strong cement produced by heating a mixture of ground materials such as calcite, silica, aluminum, and iron. Raw Anglicism, relatively uncommon. San Juan Cement Co. reported yesterday that unlike its competitor, Puerto Rican Cement, the company is not under investigation by the Consumer Affairs Department despite importing significant quantities of clinker for cement production as permitted by law. During the year, San Juan Cement receives shipments of thousands of tons of clinker, or cement paste, from a plant in Canada (The New Day, 23-10-97)
